movelist.name: Iron Defense
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Metal Claw
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Rapid Spin
movelist.effect: Rapid Spin destroys all Hazards within 5 meters, removes Leech Seeds, and removes the user’s Trapped or Stuck status. If Rapid Spin hits, the user’s speed raises 1 CS.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!

abilities.name: Slush Rush
abilities.effect: While in Hailing Weather or under half maximum Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
